_note: Body of the quadruped group (wolves, dogs, bears, sabre cats, horses, deer, elk, goats, cows, mammoths, horkers, foxes, hares, skeevers, boars): a four-legged animal with fur or hide; bleeds, breathes (drowning lands in the lungs), no torture bleedout (many creatures have no bleedout animation). No sexual parts. Parts are ordered core, lungs; keep this order: co-saves store points by part index. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups).
